name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
      This was made from the 'Self Replicating Spots' example from the ready codebase.
      
      A third 'c' reagent has been added that parameters to control its decay, diffusion and shaping, and which can have any amount of the other two reagents (a and b) as desired as input.
      
      There is feedback from this 'history' reagent back into the simulation by offsetting the F and k parameters. The strength of 'c's effect on F and k is controlled via parameters c_to_k and c_to_F.
      
      This setup is quite touchy about whether it will start properly based on some detail about the initial conditions - at least with the present initial state generator (which could probably be improved). This means that it might need to be retried/restarted a few times with differently regenerated initial states (different seeds) to get it going. It should be obvious when it is working though (wavefronts).
      
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.164
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.082
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.041
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.006
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_k">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_F">
        0.001
      </param>
      <param name="D_a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_b_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        0.0004
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_c">
        -1e-05
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_c">
        0.015
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow_norm">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (F+c_to_F*c)*(1.0f-a);
        delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((F+c_to_F*c)+(k+c*c_to_k))*b;
        delta_c = -c*cDamp + a*a_to_c + b*b_to_c + D_a_to_c * laplacian_a + D_b_to_c * laplacian_b + D_c * laplacian_c;
        c = clamp( pow( fabs(c)/c_pow_norm, c_pow )*c_pow_norm, 0.0f, 1.0f );
        
      </formula>
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <constant value="0.7">
        </constant>
        <everywhere>
        </everywhere>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-0.2" high="0.2">
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.1" y="0.1" z="0.1">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.9" y="0.9" z="0.9">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract>
        </subtract>
        <other_chemical chemical="b">
        </other_chemical>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6">
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8">
          </point3D>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true">
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="c">
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
      </low>
      <high value="1">
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15">
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0.25">
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="27">
      </timesteps_per_render>
      <show_phase_plot value="false">
      </show_phase_plot>
      <phase_plot_x_axis value="a">
      </phase_plot_x_axis>
      <phase_plot_y_axis value="b">
      </phase_plot_y_axis>
      <phase_plot_z_axis value="c">
      </phase_plot_z_axis>
    </render_settings>
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 1023 0 1023 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
